extraction.name: FOMO60K
extraction.description: A large-scale, heterogeneous dataset of 60,529 brain Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scans from 13,900 sessions and 11,187 subjects, aggregated from 16 publicly available sources. The dataset includes both clinical- and research-grade images, multiple MRI sequences, and a wide range of anatomical and pathological variability, including scans with large brain anomalies.
extraction.creator: Asbjøm Munk, Stefano Cerri, Jakob Ambsdorf, Julia Machnio, Sebastian Nørgaard Llambias, Vardan Nersesjan, Christian Hedeager Krag, Peirong Liu, Pablo Rocamora Garc´ ıa, Mostafa Mehdipour Ghazi, Mikael Boesen, Michael Eriksen Benros, Juan Eugenio Iglesias, and Mads Nielsen
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was aggregated from 16 existing publicly available sources.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: 60,529 brain MRI scans from 13,900 sessions and 11,187 subjects, spanning clinical- and research-grade imaging and multiple MRI sequences (T1, T2, FLAIR, DWI, T1ce, PD, SWI, and GRE).
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Pre-training, fine-tuning, benchmarking, and method development for self-supervised learning in medical imaging.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset is planned to be updated and expanded in future releases with additional data.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images were reoriented to RAS (Right-Anterior-Superior) orientation, affinely co-registered to the highest spatial resolution image within each session, and skull-stripped. For 4D DWI scans, b=0 volumes were extracted and specific b=1000 shell volumes were averaged.

rai:dataCollectionType.evidence: FOMO60K is derived from 16 publicly available datasets.

rai:dataCollectionRawData.evidence: a large-scale, heterogeneous dataset of 60,529 brain MRI scans from 13,900 sessions and 11,187 subjects... MRI sequence types include T1-weighted (T1), T2-weighted (T2), Fluid-Attenuated Inversion Recovery (FLAIR), and Diffusion-Weighted Imaging (DWI), among others.

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: FOMO60K is intended to support the development and benchmarking of self-supervised learning methods in medical imaging at scale. [...] The dataset can be used with no further pre-processing for pre-training.

rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan.evidence: The dataset will continue to grow in future releases as additional cohorts and modalities become available.

rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol.evidence: MRI preprocessing comprised three main steps: reorienting images to RAS (Right–Anterior–Superior) orientation, affine co-registration, and skull-stripping. All scans were first reoriented to RAS and affinely co-registered using the mri_coreg command from FreeSurfer 7.4.130, with default parameters.
